name: Swaparr (Sonarr)
author: ThijmenGThN
short_desc: Stalled-download cleanup for Sonarr: strike system, auto-remove slow/failed grabs. No web UI (headless, logs only).
description: Swaparr quietly operates in the background against your Sonarr instance: it scans active downloads every SCAN_INTERVAL, flags slow or stalled ones with a strike system, and automatically removes them (optionally from the download client too) after MAX_STRIKES. This app targets one Sonarr instance only — install it next to swaparr-radarr (same store) to cover both, one watcher per app, as upstream recommends. Headless by design: no web UI, configuration via the install form, activity in the app logs (docker logs / Runtipi log view). Supports DRY_RUN sandbox mode.

form_fields.label: Sonarr URL
form_fields.hint: URL of your Sonarr instance as reachable from this container. Prefer the container name + INTERNAL port (e.g. http://sonarr:8989); a LAN IP + host port (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8098) works too.

form_fields.label: Sonarr API key
form_fields.hint: API key of your Sonarr instance (Settings > General > API Key).

form_fields.label: Max strikes
form_fields.hint: Strikes a download must accumulate before removal (1-2 aggressive, 3-4 balanced, 5+ conservative).

form_fields.label: Max download time
form_fields.hint: Maximum time before a download is considered stalled (e.g. 2h, 120m, 4h).

form_fields.label: Ignore above size
form_fields.hint: Ignore downloads larger than this size (e.g. 25GB, 10GB, 5000MB) — large files naturally take longer.

form_fields.label: Remove from download client
form_fields.hint: Also remove the download from the download client (recommended), not only from Sonarr's queue.

form_fields.label: Strike queued downloads
form_fields.hint: When enabled, queued (not yet started) downloads are eligible for strikes instead of being bypassed.

form_fields.label: Dry run
form_fields.hint: Sandbox mode: log what would be removed without removing anything. Leave ON for the first cycles to check the logs, then turn off.
